package.description: A detailed task manager and system monitor for Windows.

en-US.description: A detailed task manager and system monitor for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: Task Manager+ shows every CPU, GPU, memory module, disk and network adapter in your PC and which programs are using each of them. It groups processes into apps, background programs and Windows components, checks digital signatures, manages autostart entries and services, and records a history of resource usage.
en-US.name: Task Manager+
